title: Chart
summary: Line, bar and donut charts plus a sparkline, drawn with thin marks, a quiet grid and one axis. Use a line for change over time, bars for magnitude across categories and a donut for parts of a whole.

demos.title: Line chart
demos.note: Change over time. Lines draw in once, and a crosshair with exact values follows the pointer. Two or more series get a legend; a single series gets a soft wash under it.

demos.title: Line chart options
demos.note: format writes the axis and tooltip values, here as currency. height sets the plot height, and area={false} removes the wash under a single series.

demos.title: Bar chart
demos.note: Magnitude across categories. Bars rise from the baseline once, in sequence. highlight keeps one bar at full strength while the rest recede; hovering a bar takes over.

demos.title: Donut chart
demos.note: Two to five parts of one whole. The centre takes the total or the headline share, and the legend carries names, values and percentages so identity never rests on colour alone.

demos.title: Sparkline and series colours
demos.note: A sparkline is a trend at a glance beside a number: no axes and no tooltip, because the number carries the value. chartColors lists the five series colours in their fixed order.
